Rafael —

Thanks for the materials and the quick turnaround. Legal reviewed your redline and had a few asks:

1) Transfer mechanism: Acme prefers SCCs as the primary transfer mechanism with a UK Addendum as an acceptable fallback only if the SCC route introduces execution delays. We can sign either but need the contract to clearly state SCCs are primary.

2) Transfer impact language: Our DPA team will want a short "Transfer Impact Appendix" that calls out: cross-border data flows, purposes for transfer (inference logs vs telemetry), retention windows, and encryption at rest/in transit. They expect 2-3 short paragraphs and a bullet list of controls.

3) Evidence: We will need a recent SOC 2 Type II summary and an export of your encryption key management (KMS) posture — high level is fine. The subprocessor CSV is helpful; please confirm whether any subprocessors are used for persistent storage of inference outputs.

4) Execution: Acme uses DocuSign. Please send envelope with Acme Legal as signatory once you have the final PDF. We prefer countersign within 5 business days.

I attached our tracked comments (Acme_Legal_remarks.docx). Happy to hop on a short call if you'd like to walk through the SCC vs IDTA tradeoffs.

Megan Liu
Head of Legal Ops
Acme Analytics
megan.liu@acme.com
